youtube.title: 🔥 This Repo Turns You Into a 10-Person Engineering Team
youtube.description:
Garry Tan ships 810× faster than he did in 2013. Same person. Different era. The difference? gstack — his open source AI engineering team.

This isn't a copilot. It's 23 specialist roles inside Claude Code. A CEO who rethinks your product. An eng manager who locks architecture. A designer who catches AI slop. A QA lead who opens real browsers. A security officer who runs OWASP audits. A release engineer who ships the PR.

Every skill feeds into the next. /office-hours writes a design doc that /plan-ceo-review challenges. /plan-eng-review writes a test plan that /qa executes. /review catches bugs that /ship verifies are fixed. Nothing falls through the cracks.

118K stars. MIT license. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Cursor, and 7 other AI coding agents. Install takes 30 seconds. One command gets you the entire stack.

Next time you ship a feature: /autoplan → implement → /ship. That's it. That's the workflow that produces 810× output.

Link in bio to the repo. Try /office-hours first. You'll know in 5 minutes if this is for you.

linkedin.text:
I coded every day in 2013. I shipped 14 logical lines per day building Bookface at YC.

In 2026? 11,417 logical lines per day. 810× faster. Same person. Different era.

The difference isn't typing speed. It's tooling. Specifically: gstack, my open source AI engineering team.

I open sourced it because this should be available to everyone. 118K GitHub stars later, it turns out people want virtual specialists who actually work.

23 roles. All slash commands:

• /office-hours → YC-style interrogation that reframes your product
• /plan-ceo-review → finds the 10-star product hiding in your request  
• /plan-eng-review → locks architecture before you write code
• /design-review → catches AI slop, rates every dimension 0-10
• /review → finds production bugs that pass CI
• /qa → opens real browsers, generates regression tests
• /cso → OWASP + STRIDE security audits
• /ship → tests, commits, opens PR

Every skill feeds into the next. The design doc from /office-hours flows into /plan-ceo-review. The test plan from /plan-eng-review flows into /qa. Nothing falls through the cracks.

This isn't about replacing engineers. It's about removing coordination overhead. One person can ship like a team when the tools encode the process.

Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Cursor, and 7 other AI agents. MIT license. Install takes 30 seconds.

If you're a founder, tech lead, or staff engineer — try /office-hours on your next feature. You'll know in 5 minutes if this is for you.

Repo: github.com/garrytan/gstack
